bagPolicy.summary: WAMU Theater enforces a clear bag policy to enhance public safety. Only clear bags, small clutches, and one-gallon clear plastic bags are allowed.
allowed: Clear bags that do not exceed 12″ x 6″ x 12″
Clear backpacks within dimension guidelines with no more than 2 pockets
prohibited: Oversized bags that cannot fit into clear bags
bagPolicy.note: Exception for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

parking.note: Paid parking is available at the Lumen Field Event Center Garage, which opens at 6 a.m. on event days and closes 2 hours after the event. Pre-purchase parking options are available for most events. Electric vehicle charging is available, but parking is not guaranteed without pre-purchase.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in WAMU Theater's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: WAMU Theater offers a variety of food and beverage options including fan favorites like chicken strips with fries, Bavarian pretzels with cheese, and handcrafted cocktails. The venue also features a Starbucks menu with espresso drinks and pastries. Outside food is allowed under specific conditions, but outside beverages are generally not permitted.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by WAMU Theater, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in WAMU Theater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Typically the WAMU Theater Box Office opens 2 hours prior to an event. Starting July 16th the Lumen Field NW Stadium box office (located on the corner of the Olympic neighborhood of the stadium along Occidental Ave) will be open Thursday, Friday, and Saturday from 10:00 a.m. - 2:30 p.m.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at WAMU Theater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
